comment: A competitor's own harness, executed here, on this repository's corpus, with this repository's models.
**And the four things that make it a measurement rather than a description**: the tool is named, **the model is
`deepseek-chat` because `OCR_LLM_URL` points at DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint**, the corpus is the
directory this project's own engine indexes, and **the tool reported its own denominator, cost and duration.**
**The OpenAI-compatible base was tried first and failed** with `POST https://api.deepseek.com/v1/v1/messages` -
a doubled path whose `/messages` shape named the protocol. **Both the wrong value and the right one are recorded
here**, because a record showing only what worked cannot explain why the obvious thing does not.
